summary: Lead research for Boxflow MVP (inventory management/workflow automation platform). Targets logistics companies, warehouses, and small businesses in Ashtabula County and Northeast Ohio that need inventory tracking, workflow automation, and supply chain management tools.

leads.fit_rationale: Active in Ashtabula since 1960, providing freight forwarding, warehousing, and distribution. Inventory management and workflow tools would optimize their operations.
Ohio-based logistics company with warehousing and distribution services. Boxflow inventory tracking would complement their existing operations.
Four warehouse locations in Akron/Mogadore serving local and national clients. Workflow automation and inventory management tools would enhance their value-added services.
Nationwide network of warehouse distribution centers. Boxflow inventory tracking could be valuable for clients in the Northeast Ohio region.
Provides warehousing and distribution services with integrated transportation. Workflow automation would streamline their supply chain solutions.

branding_quality_assessment.notes: No visual-analysis JSON available yet; branding/layout assessment deferred until screenshot analysis report exists.

site_improvements: Add barcode/QR code scanning for instant inventory entry and tracking.
Include real-time inventory dashboards with low-stock alerts.
Create workflow automation for reordering and purchase order generation.
Add multi-location inventory management for warehouses with multiple sites.
Integrate with shipping carriers for automated tracking and fulfillment.
Provide CSV import/export for easy data migration and reporting.
Include mobile app for inventory management on the warehouse floor.
Add role-based access control for team collaboration.

possible_issues: Inventory management tools need clean, efficient interfaces—cluttered design slows warehouse operations.
Without clear visual hierarchy, critical alerts (low stock, delays) may be missed.
Poor mobile design hinders floor staff who need quick inventory access.

whitelabel_potential.reason: Inventory and workflow platforms are highly white-labelable for logistics companies, warehouses, and manufacturers with custom branding and workflows.
